summary: Completed VEXOR backend and frontend regression testing. API health/status persistence, cross-client WebSocket broadcast, landing-to-workspace, channel/community switching, mobile menu/no-overflow, socket stability after 1.5s, message sending, and console-error checks all passed.
action_items: Implement and integrate real email/password authentication before presenting the auth form as production authentication.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth submit only changes React screen state; it does not validate credentials or persist an account. This is acceptable only if explicitly treated as a frontend MVP placeholder, not real authentication.
test_credentials: No credentials provided; credential guidance file is empty. Auth entry was tested with disposable values because the current flow is frontend-only.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_vexor status record through the public API; no application seed data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested WebSocket regression and desktop/mobile UI flows are passing. Future coverage should focus on real auth persistence and any subsequent community/channel CRUD implementation.
rca of the issue: The prior stale-WebSocket lifecycle regression is resolved: the frontend now updates connection state only when event handlers belong to the current socket reference. Browser status remained Conectado after 1.5 seconds, and an independent two-client test confirmed realtime message broadcast.
